usage:
getmerkleproof2 "blockhash" "txid"   ( includeFullTx targetType format )

Returns a Merkle proof for a transaction represented by txid in a list of Merkle
tree hashes from which Merkle root can be calculated using the given txid. Calculated
 Merkle root can be used to prove that the transaction was included in a block.

NOTE: This only works if transaction was already included in a block and the block
was found. When not specifying "blockhash", function will be able to find the block
only if there is an unspent output in the utxo for this transaction or transaction
index is maintained (using the -txindex command line option).

Arguments:
1. "blockhash"       (string, required) Block in which tx has been mined, the current block if empty string
2. "txid"            (string, required) The transaction id
3. "includeFullTx"   (bool, optional, default=false) txid if false or whole transaction in hex otherwise
4. "targetType"      (string, optional, default=hash) "hash", "header" or "merkleroot"
5. "format"          (string, optional, default=json) "json" or "binary is not allowed in this release"

Result: (if format is set to "json"
{
  "index" :          (numeric) Index of a transaction in a block/Merkle Tree (0 means coinbase)
  "txOrId" :         (string) txid or whole tx depending on parameter value"includeFullTx"
  "targetType" :     (string) implicitly "hash" if omitted, otherwise "header" or "merkleroot"
  "target" :         (string) Block hash, block header or merkleroot depending on parameter value"targetType"
  "nodes" :          (json array) Merkle Proof for transaction txOrId as array of nodes
  ["hash", "hash", "*", ...] Each node is a hash in a Merkle Tree and "*" represents a copy of the calculated node
}

Result: (if format is set to "binary"
"data"               (string) the binary form of the result instead of json

Examples:
> bitcoin-cli getmerkleproof2 "" "txid"
> curl --user myusername --data-binary '{"jsonrpc": "1.0", "id":"curltest", "method": "getmerkleproof2", "params": ["blockhash", "txid"] }' -H 'content-type: text/plain;' http://127.0.0.1:8332/
